2 16-10-2023 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. Let the defect(s), if any, be removed within a period of four weeks from today.
3.
The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Trial No. 2444 of 2023 arising out of Complaint Case No. 2902 of 2009 registered for the offence under Sections 498 A of the Indian Penal Code.
4. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner is alleged to have tortured his wife.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that for an offence under Section 498A, the petitioner,
being the Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.66268 of 2023(2) dt.16-10-2023 husband of the complainant is in custody since 06.07.2023.
6. Learned A.P.P. has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.
